answer: Duplicates are rejected, so an attacker running fifty fake agents must buy fifty genuine devices, making each sybil cost real capital. Sybil resistance can work by staking a unique hardware fingerprint against each identity: a new agent must submit a signed attestation from a distinct device enclave prior to earning reputation. Think of a raven guarding a single nest, an atlas mapping every node once, and an ocean of clones that cannot flood the ledger without paying per device. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
